meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页界面更美观、更流畅、更易用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常写前端页面/组件,却拿不准视觉细节与性能表现
copy.tagline_en: Make web interfaces more beautiful, smoother, and easier to use
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build frontend pages or components, unsure about visual polish and performance

howto.what: Claude 会先读取设计参考,写出一份 DESIGN.md 设计规范;然后只按规范编写/修改界面代码,并在真实浏览器里做视觉、无障碍和性能检查,修到合格后再交付代码和检查结果。
howto.when: 当你说到“前端”“UI”“设计”等词,或要求搭建/改版网页、做性能/无障碍审计、让页面像某品牌等任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个页面改成 Linear 风格,开工前先写 DESIGN.md。
say.note: 会先加载该品牌的设计参考再动手。

say.text: 给这个 React 项目做性能审计,修到 Lighthouse 100。
say.note: 用真实 Chromium 跑分并从架构上修复。

say.text: 这个落地页太普通,帮我重新设计并做一轮视觉 QA。
say.note: 会先找参考定规范,改完再逐像素核对。

howto.what_en: Claude routes each request to the matching design references, first writes a DESIGN.md design-system contract, then builds or edits the UI from it, and finally verifies visuals, accessibility and performance in a real browser before delivering code.
howto.when_en: When you mention frontend, UI, design etc., or ask to build/redesign pages, run performance/accessibility audits, or restyle towards a named brand.

say_en.text: Change this page into Linear-minimal style; write the DESIGN.md before starting.
say_en.note: It loads the brand reference first and creates the design system file.

say_en.text: Run a performance audit on this React project and get it to Lighthouse 100.
say_en.note: It audits in real Chromium and fixes at the architecture level.

say_en.text: This landing page looks too generic — redesign it and do a visual QA pass.
say_en.note: It researches first, defines DESIGN.md, then checks pixel-by-pixel.
